description: L2 v2 tendency block (plan_l2_v2.md §2, §12 #7 / #10 / #11; workflow T0565): 7 dynamic statistics per sentence segment + a track default, written as TRAIN-quantile level words (a number is also accepted). Opt-in: src/semantic/l2_v2_tendency.py only. Numbers copied from workflow/tasks/T0561/params_v2.json 'tendency' unless a key says otherwise.

segmentation.boundary: floor((end_frame_k + 1 + start_frame_{k+1}) / 2) between sentences k and k+1 (end inclusive); first segment from frame 0, last to n_frames
segmentation.merge: while > 1 segment and the shortest (earliest on a tie) is < min_frames: merge it into its shorter neighbour (tie: the following one)

rates.rule: event units (repeat units counted) whose start frame lies in the segment / segment minutes

gaze_wander.rule: share of segment frames with ||(gaze_pitch, gaze_yaw) - the track's gaze rest|| > threshold; the rest is the per-track median gaze = this person's usual gaze in the clip (plan §12 #7)

face_energy.rule: mean over segment frames of sqrt(mean_c (np.gradient(gaussian_filter1d(x_c, sigma, mode='nearest')) * hz)^2)

head_energy.rule: mean over segment frames of ||np.gradient(gaussian_filter1d(rotvec_deg, sigma, mode='nearest'))|| * hz, rotvec about the track reference

articulation.rule: over the segment's in-word frames (content-text words, start..end inclusive; >= min_frames else undefined): mean over features f (a feature = the mean of its channels) of (p90 - p10 of x_f) / sigma_f, sigma_f = TRAIN pooled std of x_f over TRAIN in-word frames (fitted)

writing.default: the track default holds all 7 (same definitions over the whole track); an undefined default is written as level 'mid' without a value
writing.segments: one entry per merged segment, t = [start, end) seconds, holding only the params whose level differs from the default; an undefined param is omitted; a segment entry with no param is not written
writing.entry: a param is {level, value} when encoded; an LLM may write a level word, a number, or {level} / {value} / {level, value}
writing.decode: value if given, else the level's TRAIN representative (median of the TRAIN segment values inside that bin); frames outside every written segment take the default
